quest.title: Astrology and the 50-Year Pact
quest.description: You and Paimon went outside Liyue, intending to set off on an adventure...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x525, Mora x31125, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Found it! This must be the ring!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's so pretty. Paimon's sure it's worth a ton of...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Ah, Paimon wasn't having any bad thoughts! Let's bring the ring back to <color=#00E1FFFF>Mr. Zhu</color>!

talks.objective: Find out what the girl who stopped you wants

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: H—How do you know about that?
How? Because I'm a master of true astrology.
If you've no other questions, let's be off.

choices.text: Oh, I'm just full of questions.

response.text: *sigh* Fine, I'll exercise a little patience, and explain.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: I am Astrologist Mona Megistus. But considering that it is most rude to misremember names, I allow others to call me Mona.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: I am on a mission from my master to retrieve a certain box from Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: It was part of an agreement she made with a friend 50 years ago. But she isn't as spry as she used to be, so now it's up to me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Not sure what getting some box back has to do with us. Why do you need us to come along?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Well... that's because I would also like to take on the guardian of the box.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: My master and her friend contended in the mystic arts all their lives without a clear victor. If I triumph here, then I will show myself to be superior to my master!

choices.text: So you want to prove yourself, huh...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Ahem, well, I want to prove the power and status of astrology, to be precise.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Now, from my predictions, I know that my master's friend has left Mondstadt, leaving her successor as the current guardian of that box.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Like me, that successor must also be one who has surpassed their teacher. I must not be careless.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: But I would prefer to assure my victory in this contest, and upon giving it some thought, you came to mind!

choices.text: But... I have no idea how astrology works.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #How did {M#he}{F#she} get involved in this anyway?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: The knowledge passed down to me from my master must be passed on in turn.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: If I were to bring my disciple to meet her, then the lead is already mine, no?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: And you are Mondstadt's great hero, my equal in status. So...

choices.text: I refuse.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Come on, you don't have to actually become my disciple. You just need to act the part.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: There's something in it for you as well, should you come with me to get that box.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Once I meet that successor and have a chance to exchange knowledge with them, I should be able to read your fate more accurately.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Then, I will have answers for you, even regarding such distant and foggy matters as gods and kin.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That does seem much faster than searching the land country by country!

choices.text: Those sound like fine conditions.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Hehe, a wise decision.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: That said, I would like to pay a certain place a visit before we go.

choices.text: Well... I guess we'll play along.
Since when was I your student?
How did you end up thinking of me?
So basically, you want to look good.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: What are you talking about? The main thing here is to use this chance to prove the power and status of astrology!

choices.text: For starters, who are you?

talks.objective: Find out what the girl who stopped you wants
Accompany Mona to say farewell to Mr. Zhu

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Well, it's no wonder that an inn set up here has no business...)

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Mona, you've come at just the right time. Did you see a jade ring while you made your way here?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: A jade ring? Can't say I have.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Oh, that's not good... that ring was given to me by my mother. But while my back was turned, it was swallowed up by a slime!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? That should be no trouble with Mona here. She's really good at astrology...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Absolutely not. Astrology is meant to be used to gain insight into reality and observe destiny itself. It's certainly not for such mundane affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But didn't you say that the owner here's been good to you?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: This is a matter of pride and one's state of mind. If an astrologist thinks that their arts can solve all problems, they will be forsaken by the starry ether.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Their divinations will lose the power to guide, and will not be able to pierce the fog of the unknown before them. Principles are principles.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Such a powerful ability, and you don't use it to earn a living? What a shame...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, I was going to put up twenty thousand Mora as compensation, if you were willing.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Twenty thousand...!

choices.text: Are you alright?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Oh, ahh, it's nothing! I... I was just thinking that the person who finds that ring must be lucky indeed, to be able to earn twenty thousand Mora just like that.

choices.text: You were just talking about an astrologist's pride...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Ahem. Yes. Of course. Still... the owner's business has had it pretty hard. It must be a truly extraordinary ring, to be worth spending this much Mora to find.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: It wouldn't be right for us to leave like this, so let's help to search for it. There may be other means we can employ besides astrology.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon knows where this is going.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, I know, I'll leave this one to you! This is the first mission I'm giving you as your master!

choices.text: But of course...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, since it was swallowed up by a slime, maybe we can use Elemental Bait to lure all the nearby slimes to us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You remember? The stuff we helped Master Diluc make.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And... Hehe, Paimon actually kept a small amount!

choices.text: Well done Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's the very best partner, right?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Seems like you already have a plan.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup. We'll be back in a jiffy!

choices.text: Don't tell me that when you get greedy, you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aw, don't sweat the small stuff.

choices.text: Guess it's become my business. Again.
Whatever happened to "principles are principles"?
What's with that look on your face?

talks.objective: Attract slimes and reclaim Mr. Zhu's lost ring

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: There is a small inn near <color=#00E1FFFF>Mt. Tianheng</color> that never sees a lot of business, even though its food is always great value for the money.

talks.objective: Defeat the slimes and search for the ring

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Thank you all very much, that ring really is very important to me.

talks.objective: Give the ring back to Mr. Zhu

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: That's it, that's the one! I thought it was lost forever!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: You actually found it. Not bad.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Mr. Zhu, you must take care of such precious things a bit better. You might not be so fortunate next time.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: You're absolutely right. How would I have faced my family if I had lost the 253rd ring my mother gave me?

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: Ah, let me explain. My family owns three jade mines, and in order to ensure that I would be able to find myself a good wife, my mother had many jade accessories made as heirlooms.

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: I think there might be over five hundred of them.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Then, why would you feel the need to set up an inn here?

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: Well, inheriting the family business too early unavoidably made things boring.

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: Thank you, all the same. Here's the Mora, as agreed. Please take it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then—

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: —Then I'll take it gladly!

choices.text: That was quick!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we did all the work!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: A disciple should act like one. How can they steal their master's thunder?

choices.text: Well...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, didn't we say we were just playing pretend?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Well, you need to start practicing now. If my rival is as smart as I think they are, they will figure you out in a heartbeat.
*stomach grumble*

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Huh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What was that rumbling sound?

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: Oh, right, you mustn't have eaten in days. I'm very sorry, I forgot that you have no...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Aaaaaaah—! Shhhhahahahaha! That didn't happen! Forget it!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: ...Hmph! Well, I suddenly feel that you have indeed contributed to our good fortune. I say we spend this money on treating you to a fine meal!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: If we travel north, we'll reach the <color=#00E1FFFF>Wangshu Inn</color>. I hear that the food there is really good, so let's go try it out!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: No need to thank me, I'm just doing as a good master should!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did she say she was treating us!? Is Paimon hearing things?

choices.text: "Let's go after her." There. I said it for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go after her! For good food!

choices.text: "She's a good person." Said it for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She's such a good person! Hehe, let's have ourselves a great meal!

choices.text: I never said I'd really be your disciple.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly!

choices.text: Even Paimon wasn't that fast!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: The owner has always been good to me, so I'd like to say a farewell before I set off.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Elemental Bait's really strong — it will attract all the slimes in the area.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Even if they're just slimes, they can be dangerous together, so we'd best prepare ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: This is your first mission, so don't mess it up.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: But if the going gets too tough for you... Well, I shall lend a hand then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you know? It's something that the Dawn Winery accidentally refined while making wine...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The formula is a secret, but it's really good at attracting slimes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And... Hehe, Paimon actually kept a small amount!

choices.text: Well done Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's the very best partner, right?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Seems like you already have a plan.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup. We'll be back in a jiffy!

choices.text: Don't tell me that when you get greedy, you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aw, don't sweat the small stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Does my ability to see through your secrets so easily not evoke any memories?

choices.text: It's been a while.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon remembers! You're that astrologist!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: That's right. It is I, Astrologist Mona Megistus.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: This time, I would like you to come with me to Mondstadt to reclaim a box that belongs to my master.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: It was part of an agreement she made with a friend 50 years ago. But she isn't as spry as she used to be, so now it's up to me.
